The issuer shows very high leverage, with shareholders’ equity of only about 3.6% of total assets (5,987M equity vs. 164,787M assets) and current liabilities exceeding current assets, indicating limited balance-sheet cushion. Liquidity is modest (current ratio 1.18) and operating profitability is thin (EBIT of 446M on revenue of 22,217M, ~2% margin), which increases vulnerability to downturns.  

DECISION: B+
